description: Makeform helps you create and manage forms from your Makeform workspace in ChatGPT. Find existing forms, inspect their fields and publication status, create a draft from a description, review proposed changes, and open the form editor. You can also request submission summaries, trends, and exports for forms you have permission to access. Publishing requires explicit confirmation. A Makeform account is required; available actions follow your Makeform plan and workspace permissions.

defaultPrompt: Show my Makeform forms and open the editor for one I choose.
Create a draft customer feedback form with name, email, rating, and comments.
Summarize submission counts and trends for my contact form.
